Chapter 576: Chapter 19: Cursed Killing (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 576: Chapter 19: Cursed Killing (Please Subscribe)

“What virtue or ability do I possess that a Prime God would descend upon me?”

In the skies above, the soul of the Mother Goddess of Lust trembled as the twenty-four Prime Gods of the world of light and the dark abyss, who had not made a move in many thousands of years.

The demigods who secretly spread their faith among humans were hardly different from worms hiding in dark corners to the eyes of the Prime Gods, who would cleanse them periodically.

The Mother Goddess of Lust had avoided several encirclements by the Rank Church, not because she was particularly powerful, but because the Main God of Rank never truly regarded her as a threat.

Of course, luck played a part as well.

“Which one of the twenty-four Prime Gods could it be?”

...

The Mother Goddess of Lust maintained her frantic pace, trying to calm her mind slightly.

She believed that the Prime God who acted did not target her specifically but had incidentally dealt with the Lust Church in the process.

“Fortunately, I wasn’t at the church.”

A look of relief crossed the face of the Mother Goddess of Lust, believing being at the church and facing that portly man made no difference between her and other believers.

“Returning to the Plateau of Myriad Nations is out of the question.”

The Mother Goddess of Lust, like a bird scared by the mere twang of a bow, thought, “Although the cost this time was grievous, at least I survived.”

The Mother Goddess of Lust’s face brightened, “As long as I survive, there’s hope to gather faith and lift high the Divine Kingdom…”

…

Underground Palace in Anpu City.

Lin Yuan stood beneath the deity statue and suddenly opened his eyes: “Found you.”

Though bound by cause and effect and separated by countless distances, Lin Yuan located the rough position of the Mother Goddess of Lust.

“Not in the Plateau of Myriad Nations?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow, “No problem.”

As long as he utilized the cause and effect, locking onto the position of the Mother Goddess of Lust was easy.

“Cursed Killing.”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew slightly solemn, and, following the rules of causality, traced the cause and unleashed a terrifying power that instantly spanned countless distances.

The Curse-Killing Skill was a way of utilizing the rules of causality.

To curse kill someone, a ‘medium’ was needed, which could be an object or the cause and effect itself between the two entities.

Moreover, the realm of the curse killer must be at least two major levels higher than the cursed, and the Mother Goddess of Lust, being a Seventh Rank Demigod, met the conditions as Lin Yuan’s true realm was Ninth Rank.

Lastly, once the Curse-Killing is successful, the curse killer needs to withstand the backlash from the causality rules, paying a substantial portion of lifespan as the cost.

The Curse-Killing Skill is heavily restricted and not frequently used in the Main Universe and Main World, mainly because the price is too high and it’s not a permanent kill, as the cursed, if talented enough, could still be ‘resurrected’ by a Supreme Being.

…

In the high skies.

The Mother Goddess of Lust, while rejoicing pver her escape from a Prime God, suddenly turned pale.

In her perception, an overwhelming, intangible force, against which she stood no chance, arrived in the blink of an eye.

“This…”

Before the Mother Goddess of Lust could form a thought, her physical soul was reduced to dust, permanently erased from this world.

…

“Dead?”

Lin Yuan sensed that his ‘causal’ connection with the Mother Goddess of Lust had vanished completely, confirming her absolute death.

If the Mother Goddess of Lust had other means of saving herself, their ‘causality’ would still exist, using causality to determine death is a mainstream method among the strong in the Main Universe and Main World.

“Hmm?”

“The backlash is coming?”

Lin Yuan’s forehead furrowed slightly, faintly feeling he had lost a trace of his lifespan.

It’s roughly equivalent to a thousand years.

“A thousand years of lifespan just to curse kill a Seventh Rank Life?” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; indeed, this was not worth it.

Unless there is some deep hatred … but for a Ninth Rank powerhouse wanting to kill a Seventh Rank, there are too many methods, and the Curse-Killing Skill has the lowest cost-effectiveness.

“A thousand years of lifespan, that’s all.”

Lin Yuan didn’t care, if this were in the Main World, he might lament the loss of a thousand years of lifespan, but in a traversing world?

Given that he already knew his residency time was limited to only 1,110 years, lifespan was the least meaningful thing to Lin Yuan here.

Even with a hundred million years of lifespan, when the time limit of residency is reached, isn’t he still required to return to the Main World?

Because of this, Lin Yuan did not hesitate to use the Curse-Killing Skill on the Mother Goddess of Lust, since any lifespan in this world was gratis anyway.

“But in this world, Eighth Layer gods, embodying the faith of all beings, seem not to have a concept of lifespan?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In this world, under the rules of heaven and earth, Fourth and Fifth Level Knights struggle to live past two hundred years, Sixth Rank Legendary Knights struggle past a thousand years.

A thousand years is the ultimate lifespan limit for lives in this world.

As for Seventh Rank Demigods? Once igniting the divine fire, their nature of life begins to change, as long as their divine fire isn’t extinguished, they won’t die and can normally live tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years with ease.

Although they are still greatly inferior to Seventh Rank Evolvers from the Main World, they are already considered to have long life compared to other beings.

Seventh Rank Demigods can certainly live tens or hundreds of thousands of years easily, but unless they lift high their Divine Kingdom, they will still die.

And Eighth Layer True Gods, let alone Ninth Rank Prime Gods, have never been heard of dying of old age unless there was a battle between gods.

…

“The Lust Church is reckoned to be dealt with.”

“It’s time to go back.”

Lin Yuan glanced around the grand hall and walked out.

Acting against the Lust Church was partly due to the grudge between Longshan Yuan and it, and partly because the region around Longshan Ling was essentially the foundation of Lin Yuan’s operations in this traversing mission.

Allowing the Lust Church, a destabilizing element, to remain nearby was problematic; who knew what trouble they could cause, potentially drawing the attention of the Rank Church again.
